meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 为已安装的 Dial 渠道新增一个电话号码，使同一 NanoClaw 安装能应答多个线路的短信和 AI 语音电话。技能会验证号码与代理组、设置线路名称与访问策略（strict 或 public）、创建消息群组并绑定，重启服务后确认新号生效。
howto.when: 当 Dial 渠道已安装，操作员希望再增加一个号码（如个人号旁再加一条支持号）时触发。若 Dial 未安装，需先使用 /add-dial 技能。

say.text: 帮我给 Dial 渠道添加一个新号码 +14155550123。
say.note: 会先引导选择代理组并设置访问权限。

say.text: 给 Dial 再加一条线路，访问设为 public，名称用 Support。
say.note: 需要确认号码归属后才会创建线路。

say.text: 我想给 Dial 增加号码并限制为 strict（仅已知用户可呼入）。
say.note: 技能会校验号码与代理组，然后完成接线。

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an existing Dial channel, so one NanoClaw install serves multiple lines. Claude validates selections, sets line name and access (strict/public), creates the group and wiring, restarts, verifies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Dial is already installed and the operator wants to add another number. Dial must be installed first; otherwise run /add-dial.

say_en.text: Please add a new number +14155550123 to the Dial channel.
say_en.note: You will be guided to select an agent group and set access.

say_en.text: Add another Dial line with public access and name Support.
say_en.note: The number must be confirmed before creation.

say_en.text: I want to add a Dial number restricted to strict mode.
say_en.note: Skill validates the number and agent, then wires it.
